snippet.title: Backfire Brigade – Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Backfire Brigade is a couch co-op game for 1-4 players, where you take on the role of a team of firefighters in action! 🧑‍🚒🔥

Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3997210/Backfire_Brigade/

Devlogs will be published periodically to showcase the game's progress and new features.

💬 Join the discussion on Discord:
https://discord.gg/CQSpaFhsCf

📌 Check out the task board:
https://translucent-surfboard-fed.notion.site/FireGround0-178fed20f41d8044bc9bcc894be18c9e?pvs=74

Stay tuned for more updates! 🚒🔥
